title: SysAdmin: Measuring Instrumental Power-Seeking in Frontier AI
description:
arXiv:2607.18239v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Power-seeking defined as behaviors where AI systems acquire resources, evade oversight, or resist termination beyond task requirements is identified as a key driver of Loss of Control (LoC) risk.
